function: Joint transmit beamforming for communication and radar sensing: learns communication beamformers, sensing beamformer and power split of a DFRC base station (p. 7).
system: MU-MISO ISAC base station, ULA with Nt=64 antennas, K=4 single-antenna users, M=6 targets, monostatic MIMO radar, TDD; no RIS; mmWave, carrier unstated (pp. 3-4, 9).
method: Deep alternating network of three fully connected subnets (communication, sensing, power), unsupervised training with Adam, plus ODAN variant with orthogonal null-space loss (pp. 7-9).
data_channel: Custom simulated multipath mmWave channel: LoS plus NLoS Gaussian path gains, ULA steering vectors; 2000 training and 1000 test examples, no 3GPP or measured data (pp. 4, 9).
test_conditions: 2000 training and 1000 test examples; sweeps of targets in channel, antennas, receive SNR, sensing threshold, penalty; no training at a different condition is stated (pp. 9-12).
baselines: Classical: SDP with CVX, null-space sensing with RZF, null-space sensing with max-min optimal communication beamforming. Learned: naive DNN (same three DNNs without alternating optimization, an ablation) (p. 9).
metrics: Average spectral efficiency (bit/s/Hz) and unfeasible probability (share of targets missing the sensing SNR threshold); detection probability enforced via SNR threshold (pp. 9-11).
complexity: Order only for the training loss: O(K Nt^2) for Loss3 versus O(Nt^3) for Loss1; no runtime, FLOPs or parameter count reported (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 4: "contribute to communication scattering paths between the BS and users" is a custom multipath model with Gaussian path gains and ULA steering vectors, not 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data; p. 13: "evaluating the proposed method on real-world data" is left as future work.
q2_support: p. 9: "the numbers of training and test examples are set as" 2000 and 1000; pp. 10-12 only sweep antennas, receive SNR, targets in the channel and threshold; no unseen scenario, band or dataset, and no adaptation, is reported.
q3_support: p. 9: "three DNNs similar to the proposed algorithm but without the alternating optimization technique" is an ablation of the proposed method; SDP, NS-RZF and NS-OPT are classical, but no earlier published learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 9: "computational complexity O(KNt2 ), while the computational complexity in Loss1 is O(Nt3 )" gives the order for the training loss; no inference complexity, runtime, FLOPs or parameter count is reported.
q5_support: p. 9: "the numbers of training and test examples are set as" 2000 and 1000 of simulated data; no code or data link is given, and p. 13 lists "real-world data" as future work.
notes: Area 5: beamforming in an ISAC system. Table I (p. 9) was read from the PDF image because the text layer omits it. q4 rests on the order of the training-loss complexity only, which the reviewer may confirm. The naive DNN is an ablation, so q3 is 0.
